subject: POC onboarding: access plan, success criteria & SSO/API key steps
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samuel Nguyen <samuel.nguyen@clearsight.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: POC onboarding: access plan, success criteria & SSO/API key steps

Hi Samuel — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed plan so we have a single source of truth for the POC onboarding. I put estimated owners and timelines below so we can unblock engineering and security.

Summary of what Clearsight wants to validate in the 4-week POC:
- Ingesting 100K tokens/day across 3 routes (assist, summarize, embeddings)
- p95 inference latency < 150ms for small context (<=512 tokens)
- Throughput: sustain 10 rps with <=250ms median latency (burstable)
- Embedding similarity within their evaluation set: cosine recall >= 92% vs their baseline
- No data exfil (SSO + IP allowlist) and audit logs for token usage

Access and provisioning items (requested now):
1) Okta SSO invites for 3 users: samuel.nguyen@clearsight.ai, lisa.park@clearsight.ai, procurement@clearsight.ai — action: Laura to send invite + verify assertion mapping.
2) API/test keys for staging: one long-lived read-only test key (name: clearsight-stg-test) + one short-lived key for load tests (24h). Aditya to create and drop into vault; we will rotate after each major run.
3) IP allowlist for their staging runner: expect CIDRs from Clearsight; we'll pre-populate suggested entries.

Owners & timeline (proposal):
- Week 0 (this week): SSO invites + DocuSign MPA signed (Laura, Evelyn) — target 2 business days
- Week 1: Provision staging keys + IP allowlist; share test dataset (Aditya, Marcus)
- Week 2: Baseline runs + weekly sync (Ben + Samuel)
- Week 3: Optimization pass, quantization/serve tweaks if needed (Aditya + Marcus)

Next steps: Samuel — can you confirm the Okta admin email and the CIDR ranges you want whitelisted? Procurement — any Docs or PO timeline we should expect?

Attachments: Cleansheet MAP draft (attached), high-level POC checklist (poc-checklist.xlsx)

Thanks — I’ll hold a calendar stub for a Wed sync next week but will only finalize once we get DocuSign back.

—
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0191

From: Samuel Nguyen <samuel.nguyen@clearsight.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lisa Park <lisa.park@clearsight.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC onboarding: access plan, success criteria & SSO/API key steps

Thanks Evelyn — this is perfect and aligns with our expectations. Quick answers below: 

1) Okta admin: okta-admin@clearsight.ai (Lisa will confirm once she’s back from travel)
2) CIDRs for staging runner: 198.51.100.0/24 and 203.0.113.128/25 (we'll also provide a static NAT IP for the load generator if needed)
3) Procurement: procurement@clearsight.ai is the right contact; we can sign the MPA this week — no PO required for the POC.

Success criteria clarification: the Clearsight engineering team wants two pass/fail checks to be gold: 
- Latency: p95 <= 150ms for <=512 tokens (they will provide a 2000-sample benchmark)
- Quality: embedding recall >= 92% on their validation set 

We are good to receive the staging keys and the Okta invites. Also, can you add an audit log feed (S3) for token usage at hourly granularity? We want to ingest logs into our observability pipeline.

On the calendar: Wed 12/10 10:30am PT works for us for the kickoff call.

—Samuel
Samuel Nguyen
Director of ML Engineering | Clearsight AI

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Dec 2026 10:50:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: POC onboarding: access plan, success criteria & SSO/API key steps

Folks — forwarding Clearsight confirmation. Marcus/Aditya: can you confirm the following by EOD?
- Create a staging API key named "clearsight-stg-test" and a second ephemeral key for load runs (24h TTL). Please drop secrets into our Vault under /teams/clearsight/poc with read access for samuel.nguyen@clearsight.ai and lisa.park@clearsight.ai.
- Okta SAML mapping: name_id should be sent as email; groups claim should include 'engineering' if present. Confirm required attributes.
- Audit logs: export token usage to s3://redwood-logs/clearsight-poc/hourly/ (CSV gzip) — retention 90 days.

If any of this is blocked by quota or security policy, call it out and we’ll escalate.

Thanks,
Ben

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Dec 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: POC onboarding: access plan, success criteria & SSO/API key steps

Looping back with the action items status: 
- Staging keys: created. Names and notes: clearsight-stg-test (long-lived, scoped to model: redwood-mini-v1, read/generate), clearsight-stg-load-ephemeral-20261209 (24h TTL). Keys stored in Vault and I shared a read-only secret version with samuel.nguyen@clearsight.ai (IAM ACL applied).
- IP allowlist: added 198.51.100.0/24 and 203.0.113.128/25 to the staging firewall rules, with a comment referencing RDW-2026-078.
- Audit logs: configured hourly export to s3://redwood-logs/clearsight-poc/hourly/; IAM role created for clearsight-ingest (they can pull). Retention policy 90 days.

Notes/next: I could use a one-time SSO test token and an Okta SP metadata file to validate assertions. Laura, can you send the invite and metadata when ready? Also, for the load test key I left rate limits at 50 rps but can raise for the single-run with a temporary quota bump — Ben, do you want me to request that now?

Attachments referenced: poc-checklist.xlsx (updated) — see the staging keys section.

—Aditya

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samuel Nguyen <samuel.nguyen@clearsight.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Dec 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC onboarding: access plan, success criteria & SSO/API key steps

Samuel — I just sent the Okta SSO invite to okta-admin@clearsight.ai and Lisa's personal account. You should see the email from Okta titled "Redwood Inference — Application Access". The SP metadata is attached to the invite.

A few security notes:
- API keys issued are limited to the staging environment and model family redwood-mini-v1. Do not use for production.
- We will rotate the long-lived key after the POC and you will be notified 48h before rotation.
- The audit export is redact-ready; logs will include token id, request route, model, prompt length, latency_ms, and timestamp. Personal data within prompts is not redacted by default — please avoid uploading regulated data during the POC.

If everything looks good I’ll mark the MPA as countersigned once we have procurement confirmation. Looking forward to the kickoff on Wed 12/10 10:30am PT.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
